notes: LARA failure-category dictionary, seeded from the 2026-05-22 venmo-5 deep-dive (run bv1ew2sc3). Each category names a recurrent failure mode observed in the orchestrator's run log. The parser uses 'signatures' (substring matches against the run trace) to auto-tag occurrences; 'seen_in_tasks' and 'count' are maintained per analysis pass.

categories.description: Explorer plan named a non-existent API or the wrong API for the task goal.

example.snippet: Plan step 3: 'call_api(phone, show_contact_relationships, ...) to identify roommates' — that API returns relationship TYPES, not people

categories.description: Plan step contained placeholder language ('once identified', empty-string args, future-tense identification) that was never resolved at execution time.

example.snippet: Plan step 2: "find_contact('') for each coworker (Will do this for each coworker once identified)"

categories.description: Plan passed the plural form of a relationship word ('coworkers') where the API expects the singular ('coworker').

example.snippet: Plan step 5: search_contacts(relationship='coworkers') — plural; correct form is 'coworker'

categories.description: Task referenced a relationship group ('my friends/roommates/coworkers/siblings') but the plan omitted the phone search_contacts step entirely.

example.snippet: Plan never calls search_contacts; relies on 'friends' as a Venmo concept

categories.signature_notes: Needs structural plan check, not a substring. Detect by: task text contains group word, plan contains no phone-app step.

categories.description: Plan included a phone get_current_date_and_time step but no later step actually consumed the computed date strings.

example.snippet: Plan step 3 computes date, but later steps don't pass min_created_at/max_created_at

categories.signature_notes: Structural — needs plan inspection. Detect: get_current_date_and_time in plan AND no later step has min_created_at/max_created_at.

categories.description: Plan picked the wrong entity type (e.g. payment_requests for a 'payments I received' task that needs transactions).

example.snippet: Task says 'payments I received' (transactions); plan called show_received_payment_requests (pending bills)

categories.signature_notes: Co-occurs with E-ID-TYPE-MISMATCH because the wrong entity's IDs feed the action APIs.

categories.description: Plan picked the wrong data source for the task semantics (e.g. show_social_feed-only when broader show_transactions data was needed).

example.snippet: Task expected likes on transactions involving siblings; plan restricted to social_feed which contained none of them

categories.description: Executor invented an API name on retry instead of consulting docs or the specialist prompt.
Executor invented names and emails to fill plan placeholders ('Alice', 'Bob', '@example.com').
Executor called a bootstrap helper (find_contact, login_to_app, fetch_all_pages) as if it were an AppWorld API.

example.snippet: call_api('phone', 'find_contact', token, name=name) — find_contact is a bootstrap helper, not a phone API

categories.description: Executor searched contacts by the user's own name (or another wrong query) when trying to find a group.

example.snippet: search_contacts(query='Melissa Bailey') — searched for own name; returned random surname matches as 'potential_roommates'

categories.description: When the filter set was empty or unresolved, executor performed actions on the unfiltered superset.

example.snippet: Filter for roommates failed; agent then liked ALL social feed transactions indiscriminately

categories.description: Executor reused a stale access token across many steps without re-login on 401.
signatures: access token is missing, invalid or expired

example.snippet: Step 6: 401 'token expired'; agent re-logged in step 7 only after failing

categories.description: Action API called with an ID from a different entity type (e.g. payment_request_id passed as transaction_id).
signatures: You are not authorized to comment on this transaction
You are not authorized to view this transaction

categories.description: Paginated API called with call_api instead of fetch_all_pages → only first 5 items processed.

example.snippet: social_feed = call_api('venmo', 'show_social_feed', token) — only first page (5 items), missed sibling transactions on later pages

categories.signature_notes: Hard to detect from log alone; needs paginated-API allow-list cross-check.

categories.description: Optional API parameter explicitly passed as None → 422 validation error.
signatures: value is not a valid email address

example.snippet: show_transactions(user_email=None, min_created_at=..., ...) → 422 'value is not a valid email address'

categories.description: After a 4xx/5xx error, executor retried the same wrong API call with a minor variation rather than reconsidering the API choice.

example.snippet: Step 6 failed with 422 'not authorized to view'; step 7 retried the same call without find_contact check, hit same 422

categories.description: Agent called complete_task on an ACTION task with zero successful state-changes after action APIs all errored.

example.snippet: All 3 show_transactions calls failed (409 'user does not exist'); agent still called complete_task(answer=None) with empty action set

categories.signature_notes: Structural — detect by: complete_task called AND no successful action API (like_*, create_*, send_*, place_order, approve_*, deny_*, delete_*) in any step's output.
